answer: A useful Sybil brake is a per-identity stake slashable on proven duplicate control. An agent locks a bond, and rewards go only to bonded identities whose work survives review. When accounts are linked by shared payout, device, or work fingerprint, every linked bond burns. A cluster of hundreds of synthesized identities must post hundreds of bonds, so faking a crowd costs linearly more while payoff per identity stays flat. A plume of decoys thus ends like a stranded voyage that must pay its freight in shale, wealthless by construction.
